description: Corrected secondary structure (beta pairing required), long-range contact density, and compactness of the PRM5 AlphaFold model
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pdb = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P40476-F1-model_v6.pdb", timeout=120).text
ca={}; plddt={}
for L in pdb.splitlines():
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        i=int(L[22:26]); ca[i]=(float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])); plddt[i]=float(L[60:66])
idx=sorted(ca); X=np.array([ca[i] for i in idx]); P=np.array([plddt[i] for i in idx]); n=len(idx)
def d(a,b): return float(np.linalg.norm(X[a]-X[b]))

helix=np.zeros(n,bool); ext=np.zeros(n,bool)
for i in range(n-4):
    if abs(d(i,i+3)-5.3)<0.8 and abs(d(i,i+4)-6.4)<0.9: helix[i:i+5]=True
for i in range(n-3):
    if not helix[i] and abs(d(i,i+2)-6.7)<0.7 and abs(d(i,i+3)-9.9)<1.2: ext[i:i+4]=True

# A real beta strand needs a paired partner strand: CA-CA < 5.5 A with |i-j| > 4
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=-1)
sep=np.abs(np.subtract.outer(np.arange(n),np.arange(n)))
paired=np.array([ (ext & (D[i]<5.5) & (sep[i]>4)).any() for i in range(n)]) & ext
print(f"residues with extended backbone geometry : {ext.sum():3d} ({100*ext.mean():.1f}%)")
print(f"  of those, with a beta-pairing partner  : {paired.sum():3d} ({100*paired.mean():.1f}%)  -> TRUE beta sheet content")
print(f"helical residues                         : {helix.sum():3d} ({100*helix.mean():.1f}%)")
ss=np.where(helix,'H',np.where(paired,'E','C'))
print(f"final: helix {100*(ss=='H').mean():.1f}%  sheet {100*(ss=='E').mean():.1f}%  coil/extended-unpaired {100*(ss=='C').mean():.1f}%")

# long-range tertiary contacts (hallmark of a folded domain)
lr = ((D<8.0)&(sep>12)).sum()/2
print(f"\nlong-range CA contacts (<8 A, |i-j|>12): {int(lr)}  = {lr/n:.3f} per residue")
print("  (a compact globular domain typically gives >1.5 per residue)")
Rg=np.sqrt(((X-X.mean(0))**2).sum(1).mean()); print(f"Rg = {Rg:.1f} A vs globular expectation 2.2*N^0.38 = {2.2*n**0.38:.1f} A (ratio {Rg/(2.2*n**0.38):.2f})")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,6.6),height_ratios=[2.2,1])
ax=axes[0]
ax.fill_between(idx,0,P,color='#9aa7b8',alpha=.35,lw=0); ax.plot(idx,P,color='#2b4c7e',lw=1.4)
for y,c,lab in [(90,'#1b7f3b','very high'),(70,'#c77b14','confident'),(50,'#b4413d','low')]:
    ax.axhline(y,color=c,ls='--',lw=.9); ax.text(320,y,lab,color=c,va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(75,98,color='#1b7f3b',alpha=.18); ax.text(86.5,104,'TM helix 75-98\nmean pLDDT 93.9',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#1b7f3b')
ax.axvspan(1,74,color='#777777',alpha=.10); ax.text(37,104,'Ser/Thr-rich 1-74\nmean pLDDT 59.6',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#555')
ax.axvspan(99,318,color='#b4413d',alpha=.07); ax.text(208,104,'cytoplasmic tail 99-318, mean pLDDT 52.3',ha='center',fontsize=8.5,color='#8c3330')
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,318); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_xticks([])
ax.set_title('PRM5 (P40476) AlphaFold model: mean pLDDT 57.2, only 18.6% of residues above 70\n'
             'Foldseek 0 hits vs PDB100 and AFDB50 in both 3Di-AA and TM-align modes; PGK1 control returns 271 PDB hits',
             fontsize=10.5,loc='left')
ax2=axes[1]; col={'H':'#2b7fbd','E':'#d08c1f','C':'#d6d6d6'}
for i,c in enumerate(ss): ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((idx[i]-.5,0),1,1,color=col[c],lw=0))
ax2.set_xlim(1,318); ax2.set_ylim(0,1); ax2.set_yticks([]); ax2.set_xlabel('residue')
ax2.set_title(f'Model secondary structure: helix {100*(ss=="H").mean():.0f}% (blue, almost all the TM segment), '
              f'paired beta sheet {100*(ss=="E").mean():.0f}% (orange), coil/extended {100*(ss=="C").mean():.0f}% (grey). '
              f'Rg {Rg:.0f} A vs {2.2*n**0.38:.0f} A expected if globular.',fontsize=9,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
